monarch.definition: Large migratory American butterfly having deep orange wings with black and white markings.

swallowtail.definition: A man's full-dress jacket with two long tapering tails at the back.

painted-lady.definition: A widespread orange, brown, black, and white butterfly species scientifically known as Vanessa cardui.
painted-lady.exampleUsage: A painted lady rested on a flower in the garden.

admiral.definition: The supreme commander of a fleet.

skipper.definition: To work as the skipper on a vessel.

fritillary.definition: Butterfly with brownish wings marked with black and silver.

sulphur.definition: To treat with sulphur in order to preserve.

viceroy.definition: Showy American butterfly resembling the monarch but smaller.

caterpillar.definition: A young insect that looks like a worm before becoming a butterfly or moth.
caterpillar.exampleUsage: The caterpillar was identified during the lesson.

chrysalis.definition: Pupa of a moth or butterfly enclosed in a cocoon.

butterfly.definition: A flying insect with colourful wings.
butterfly.exampleUsage: The butterfly was identified during the lesson.

metamorphosis.definition: A striking change in appearance or character or circumstances.

molt.definition: Periodic shedding of the cuticle in arthropods or the outer skin in reptiles.
molt.exampleUsage: The molt was identified during the lesson.

instar.definition: An insect or other arthropod between molts.
instar.exampleUsage: The instar was identified during the lesson.

emerge.definition: To come up to the surface of or rise.

wing.definition: (in flight formation) a position to the side and just to the rear of another aircraft.

antenna.definition: A device that sends or receives radio and television signals.

proboscis.definition: The human nose (especially when it is large).

thorax.definition: The middle region of the body of an arthropod between the head and the abdomen.

abdomen.definition: The region of the body of a vertebrate between the thorax and the pelvis.

eye.definition: Good discernment (either visually or as if visually).

leg.definition: A structure in animals that is similar to a human leg and used for locomotion.
leg.exampleUsage: The leg was identified during the lesson.

scale.definition: A device that measures how heavy a person or object is.

vein.definition: A blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart.

milkweed.definition: Any of numerous plants of the genus Asclepias having milky juice and pods that split open releasing seeds with downy tufts.

lavender.definition: A small purple plant with a strong pleasant smell.

zinnia.definition: Any of various plants of the genus Zinnia cultivated for their variously and brightly colored flower heads.

marigold.definition: Any of various tropical American plants of the genus Tagetes widely cultivated for their showy yellow or orange flowers.

sunflower.definition: A tall plant with a large yellow flower and edible seeds.

coneflower.definition: Any of various plants of the genus Rudbeckia cultivated for their large usually yellow daisies with prominent central cones.

aster.definition: Any of various chiefly fall-blooming herbs of the genus Aster with showy daisylike flowers.

lantana.definition: A genus of about 150 species of flowering shrub, commonly known as shrub verbenas or lantanas.

verbena.definition: Any of numerous tropical or subtropical American plants of the genus Verbena grown for their showy spikes of variously colored flowers.

buddleia.definition: Tropical shrub having clusters of white or violet or yellow flowers.

mating.definition: The act of pairing a male and female for reproductive purposes.

migration.definition: The periodic passage of groups of animals (especially birds or fishes) from one region to another for feeding or breeding.
migration.exampleUsage: The migration was identified during the lesson.

camouflage.definition: An outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something.

territorial.definition: Of or relating to a territory.

pathway.definition: A bundle of myelinated nerve fibers following a path through the brain.

bench.definition: The reserve players on a team.

fountain.definition: A structure that sends water upward and lets it fall back down.

trellis.definition: To train on a trellis, as of a vine.

greenhouse.definition: A building with glass walls or a roof for growing plants.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

magnifying-glass.definition: A handheld tool uses a curved lens to make nearby details appear larger for close viewing or reading.

net.definition: A net stretched across a court or between players.

camera.definition: Equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other).
